english.notes:
(i) Section 105 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 makes special provisions for this offence in relation to ships and aircraft.
(ii) Section 106 of the Act applies where a person is convicted of this offence and the unauthorised use of the wireless telegraphy station/apparatus continues after the conviction.
(iii) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(iv) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(v) The The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011 introduced a £100 fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act from 1st October 2011. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).

other.penalty:
Offence consisting of a contravention, in relation to receiving apparatus, of regulations made under section 45 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006:- A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

All other offences under this section: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

The amount of the fixed penalty is £100, see paragraph 2 of Schedule 4 to the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 and regulations 2 and 3 of the Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011 (in force from 1st October 2011).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
